title: Khayber Shikan Di Dhee Haan
body:
Khayber shikan di dhee haan, Zainab hai mera naa.
<<DIVIDER>>
Vaikhan gai log saray, fathhah karan gi Shaam.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mouloud-e-kaba jera, Mera baba murtaza ey
Jibreel jaey malaaik, is dar day nay ghulam.
<<DIVIDER>>
Asee jan deyan fasiq, maloun teri niyat
Aj mei fana karan gi, tere zulm da nizaam.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sabath karan gi aj mei, mera veer hey namaazi
Aakhay ga ey zamana, haq da hain tu Imam.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sharam-o-haya di malka, day naal jayri beethi
Fasiq day naal jis dum, karni paee kalaam.
<<DIVIDER>>
Arshan thay hoor-o-ghilman, ronday nay zaar-o-zaaran
Jad karbalaach aaee, mazloomiath di Shaam.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kirthaas thay kalam da, matam vee horeya see
Likhiya Saeed aakir, jud haal ey tamam.
